summary: Maintenance proceedings: Appellant challenged High Court's reduction of interim maintenance under CrPC 125 from ₹20,000 to ₹10,000 per month; key issue: whether Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986 supersedes CrPC 125 for divorced Muslim women; Appellant argued Section 125 is inapplicable if 1986 Act exists; Amicus contended secular provisions of CrPC 125 remain available despite personal law remedy; Court analyzed historical perspective, statutory interpretation principles, non-obstante clauses in Sections 3 and 4 of 1986 Act, and constitutional implications under Articles 14, 15, 21; examined conflict in High Court decisions regarding interplay between secular maintenance law and personal law remedies for Muslim women post-divorce; bench considered harmonious construction principle for general vs special statutes.
legal_provisions_cited: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986 s.3
Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986 s.4
